summary: Implemented the file-reading progress API in rich/progress.py: a private _Reader wrapper that advances a progress task as bytes are read (and resets it on seek), Progress.read(file, total=None, task_id=None, description, update_period) accepting a path or file-like object (total required for file objects), and a module-level rich.progress.read helper that starts its own Progress and stops it on close. Added five tests to tests/test_progress.py and a CHANGELOG entry. Nothing was run, per instructions; verification was by reading only. Nothing was committed.
